caption: AI drafts can sound confident while hiding errors. This carousel provides a compact, repeatable verification workflow for AI-generated research. Use the five prompts to diagnose, improve, apply, verify, and refine. Ready to test on your next AI draft? #AI #Productivity #Founders #DecisionMaking

slides.title: Reality check: AI claims unreliable
slides.body: AI drafts read confident yet unreliable. Here are five prompts to diagnose, improve, apply, verify, and refine.

slides.title: 1. Diagnose reliability
slides.body: Input: [PASTE AI TEXT HERE]. Identify debatable claims and citations; rate credibility (1-5); flag unverifiable statements; list sources.

slides.title: 2. Improve credibility
slides.body: Input: debunked claims list from slide 2. Task: rewrite clearly, add citations and access dates, remove unsupported claims. Output: bullets.

slides.title: 3. Apply verification
slides.body: Input: [PASTE AI DRAFT HERE]. Task: diagnose, attach verifiable sources, compute trust score, deliver verdict and suggested edits. Output: verdict.

slides.title: 4. Cross-check results
slides.body: Input: [CITATIONS]. Task: search each citation independently; note discrepancies, add context; output: match score and brief rationale.

slides.title: 5. Refine workflow
slides.body: Input: [VERIFIED RESULTS]. Task: integrate prompts into a reusable SOP; provide a one-page checklist; test on 1 new document.

slides.title: Takeaway
slides.body: Conclusion: verification beats polish. Save this workflow to ensure AI outputs are verifiable, and share with teammates.
